definitions.explanation: The part of the leg just below the kneecap, or — most commonly — the length of clothing or footwear that reaches to just below the knee. Used in clothing measurements and fashion descriptions.

examples.japanese: {膝下|ひざした}{丈|たけ}のスカートを{選|えら}んだ。
{転|ころ}んで{膝下|ひざした}を{怪我|けが}した。
examples.english: I fell and injured myself below the knee.

examples.japanese: {制服|せいふく}の{規定|きてい}でスカートの{長|なが}さは{膝下|ひざした}{五|ご}センチまでと{決|き}められている。
examples.english: School uniform rules specify that skirt length must be no more than five centimeters below the knee.

notes:
Compound of {膝|ひざ} (knee) + {下|した} (below). The same characters can also be read ひざもと in formal/literary contexts (meaning 'at one's knee' or 'in one's care'), but ひざした is the common reading in modern use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膝下|ひざした}{丈|たけ}: knee-length
- {膝下|ひざした}まで: to below the knee
- {膝下|ひざした}ソックス: knee-high socks
- {膝下|ひざした}{五|ご}センチ: five centimeters below the knee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {膝上|ひざうえ}: above the knee — the opposite
- ふくらはぎ: calf — the muscle on the back of the lower leg
